symptom: every open through a symlink fails with ELOOP on ARM; df warns on /etc/mtab
cause: musl adds its O_LARGEFILE (0400000) to every open: x86_64's O_NOFOLLOW in the protocol; 4 open flags differ between aarch64 and x86_64
detected_by: filetest FAIL read through the link
lesson: any flag or struct crossing the protocol needs a per-arch check

symptom: dash and zsh jump to pc=0 lr=0 on ARM
cause: the protocol's x86_64 struct stat (144 bytes) written over aarch64's (128): the saved return address smashed
lesson: convert structs field by field per arch

symptom: (feared) epoll_event differs: 16 bytes on aarch64, 12 packed on x86_64
cause: not a bug: the runtime implements epoll in the process on top of poll, with musl's own struct epoll_event: aarch64's layout end to end
lesson: check where a struct actually crosses a boundary before converting it

symptom: timeouts past 2.1 s and offsets past 2 GiB cut; /proc shows wrong numbers on wasm32
cause: long is 32 bits on wasm32: server args and %lu formats
lesson: use int64_t/PRIu64 in the protocol and server

symptom: lines pasted together lost after the first ran a program
cause: a canonical read() returned every ready line; POSIX: one line

symptom: dash never wakes from its first read on wasmkit
cause: one wake-up (notify count 1) went to the program that exec'd away, still waiting on the slot's word
detected_by: counters in shared memory (logs changed the timing)
lesson: wake every waiter; heisenbugs need counters, not prints

symptom: init restarted twice, in another slot, output mixed
cause: musl calls exit if exit_group returns; the server took it for the new init
lesson: a process must never call again after exit

symptom: the restarted init dies at once
cause: the console hang-up SIGHUP when the old session leader exits reaches the new init

symptom: disk hangs after restoring a QEMU snapshot
cause: sDDF virtio-blk did not negotiate VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1: QEMU treated it as legacy on load

symptom: rc: s6-rc failed at every ARM boot
cause: netcfg apply failed with no network; sshd needs net
lesson: services must idle, not fail, when their hardware is absent

symptom: console blank but 'connected' on a second device
cause: QEMU's socket chardev serves one client

symptom: 7;40R typed at the shell after login
cause: every viewer answered the cursor-position query, and QEMU's vc too

symptom: a scripted password is lost; Retype never comes
cause: passwd flushes pending input (TCSAFLUSH) when it turns the echo off; the script typed too fast

symptom: filetest FAILs with EACCES as a normal user
the demo disk carried the owner's password hash and shell history
cause: made from the used ARM disk
detected_by: login asked for an unknown password
lesson: scrub every disk that leaves the machine

symptom: gzip does not build for aarch64
cause: gzip.h's head macro renames struct _aarch64_ctx's head field in <bits/signal.h>, which gzip.c includes after it
lesson: macros named like common fields break other arches' headers

symptom: Ctrl-C does not stop a loop with no system calls on ARM
cause: not implemented: x86's return path jumps with ret; on aarch64 no register is free for the branch back
fix: the frame goes back to the server (POSIX_SYS_ASYNC_RETURN), which writes every register
lesson: when user code cannot restore its own state, the server can

symptom: s6-rc failed at boot in the smoke test only; s6-rc killed by SIGILL
cause: the test disk had the new apps but the old s6 binaries, linked with the old crt0 whose async entry was a brk stub, while the new server delivers asynchronous signals on ARM
fix: the test disk gets the whole install.cmds
lesson: a test disk must hold exactly what the build installs; runtime changes reach every static program

symptom: proctest FAIL 6 simultaneous children (errno 12: Out of memory), as user, in the smoke test
cause: not reproduced: gone on a disk made from scratch by a full build (make DISK=$(BUILD_DIR)/fresh-disk.img); the failing runs used the old demo disk plus install.cmds, after partial builds
fix: tests now start from a brand-new disk and a full build (tools/test/smoke.sh); posix_server logs every denied page with its reason ("ev":"page-denied": budget, leaf, window, frame:cslots|pool|copy|map, map) and the smoke test prints those lines when it fails
lesson: test on fresh disks after full builds; a resource failure needs a log line that names which limit said no
